notes:
Vekil Pro is a practice-management and legal-research app for lawyers in Turkey. The interface is Turkish.

ACCOUNT: No demo account is needed. Sign-up is free and takes seconds (email + password). There is no invitation, no waiting list and no manual approval.

WHAT IS FREE: case files, clients, hearings, deadlines, calendar, reminders, legal calculators, petition templates, and unlimited full-text search of Turkish court decisions (Yargitay / Danistay).

WHAT IS PAID: unlimited records and the finance module (Vekil Pro, 399 TRY/month) and the AI assistant (Vekil Pro AI, 2999 TRY/month). Both are auto-renewing subscriptions in one group and can be tested with a StoreKit sandbox account. If a screen shows a lock icon, it is a paywall, not a defect.

CONTENT: The case-law texts are public decisions published by Turkish courts. Criminal decisions describe violent and sexual offences in factual legal language; this is why the age rating was declared 12+ rather than 4+.

PRIVACY: No advertising, no tracking, no IDFA. Text a user explicitly sends to the AI assistant is transmitted to a third-party model provider, and that transfer requires the user's separate, revocable consent; without consent the AI features stay off and everything else works.
